stem: For a male patient, what physical measurement marks the official clinical onset of puberty (gonadarchy)?

options.text: The onset of the peak height velocity (growth spurt)

explanation: This volume, measured by an orchidometer, is the first clinical sign of true gonadal activation in boys.
rationale: Clinicians use a tool called an orchidometer to determine this specific volume.

optionExplanations.A: This volume, measured by an orchidometer, is the first clinical sign of true gonadal activation in boys.
optionExplanations.B: Body hair is a sign of adrenarchy, which may occur before or independently of true gonadarchy.
optionExplanations.C: Penile growth varies and is not the standardized marker for the beginning of gonadarchy.
optionExplanations.D: In boys, the growth spurt typically happens later in puberty, once testicular volume reaches $10$ to $12\text{ ml}$.

source.hint: Clinicians use a tool called an orchidometer to determine this specific volume.
